tool: Playwright CLI with an isolated local Chrome session

checks.result: A normal fake audit, long fake audit exercise, short fake audit exercise, and protected loading probe were visible together as four independently selectable task cards.
A suspected problem remained isolated in its own waiting state while other task cards retained their own progress and controls.
The cancel action required an explicit confirmation before the local request and affected only the selected task.
The long exercise paused at 1/6 with no active resource, then resumed to 4/6 and waiting_user without restarting the task.
After the local application was restarted against the same isolated temporary data root, the console restored six persisted Jobs.
Keyboard navigation focused the skip link first and Enter moved focus to the main content landmark.
With reduced motion emulated, the inspected primary button transition duration was 0.00001 seconds.
The browser session recorded zero console errors, zero console warnings, and only requests to 127.0.0.1.

limitations: The four layouts used equivalent CSS viewports; Windows desktop DPI settings were not changed, so this is not native Windows DPI evidence.
No finance user performed this automated validation.
No formal screen-reader session was run; the result covers keyboard focus and semantic browser inspection only.
